_comment: Homebrew profession abilities, keyed by THEME. Each theme is an ordered ladder of abilities tagged with a power level 0-5 (0=garbage .. 5=top), matching the campaign's profession tier ladder. profession_abilities.py picks abilities near a target power derived from the profession's tier (from its name) and the rank band (rank-5 entries pick a weaker band than the rank-15 True-Calling entry). Each ability is rendered as a class-feature-style block on the FoundryVTT sheet: a bold name + flavor/mechanics HTML, optionally with pf1 'changes' (passive bonuses that stack onto the bundled item), 'contextNotes' (conditional notes), and a 'uses' pool. Descriptions support {class}/{level}/{half_level} placeholders filled from the actual character. Mechanical formulas use pf1 v11 syntax (ifelse()/gte(), @abilities.*.mod, @attributes.hd.total). Keep formulas conservative; anything not safely automatable is descriptive-only.

martial.name: Drilled Footwork (Ex)
martial.desc: Endless drilling keeps you balanced and ready. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC and to CMD whenever you are not flat-footed.

martial.name: Weapon Discipline (Ex)
martial.desc: You have trained relentlessly with your favored weapon. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and a +1 bonus on damage rolls with it (treat as Weapon Focus and the start of Weapon Specialization).

martial.name: Maneuver Training (Ex)
martial.desc: Choose two combat maneuvers (such as disarm, trip, grapple, or sunder). You gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made with those maneuvers, and using them does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

contextNotes.text: +2 CMB and no AoO with your two chosen maneuvers

martial.name: Brawler's Fury (Ex)
martial.desc: As a swift action you can enter a focused fury for 1 minute, gaining the benefit of a single combat feat you do not possess (you must meet its prerequisites). You can use this once per day.

martial.name: Weapon Training (Ex)
martial.desc: Like a veteran fighter, you have mastered a whole group of weapons. You gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls with weapons of your trained group; the campaign treats your effective training as eight levels higher than normal, so this bonus is already strong for your level.

martial.name: Armor Training (Ex)
martial.desc: You wear armor like a second skin. Reduce your armor check penalty by 2 (minimum 0) and increase your armor's maximum Dexterity bonus by 2. The campaign treats your armor training as eight levels higher, and you move at full speed in medium armor.

martial.name: Martial Flexibility (Ex)
martial.desc: You adapt mid-fight like a brawler. As a swift action you gain the benefit of one combat feat for 1 minute (or two feats as a move action). You can use this a number of times per day equal to 3 + half your level, and the chosen feats can satisfy each other's prerequisites.

martial.name: Martial Training (initiator)
martial.desc: A master-at-arms taught you the secrets of a martial discipline. You become an initiator: you learn three maneuvers and one stance from a single Path of War discipline, with an initiator level equal to half your character level. You ready and recover these maneuvers as a martial adept.

martial.name: Peerless Warrior (Ex)
martial.desc: You fight as a legend of the battlefield. You gain a +4 bonus on attack and damage rolls and a +2 dodge bonus to AC. Once per round when you confirm a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your level + your Strength modifier) or be staggered for 1 round. You treat every weapon you wield as though it had a +2 enhancement bonus.

ki.name: Still Mind (Ex)
ki.desc: Your meditative training steadies your spirit. You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

ki.name: Lesser Ki Pool (Su)
ki.desc: You have a small reservoir of ki equal to half your level + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). As a swift action you can spend 1 ki point to increase your speed by 20 feet for 1 round, or to gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC until your next turn.

ki.name: Swift Recovery (Su)
ki.desc: So long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you recover double the normal hit points and ability damage from resting and natural healing. You may spend 1 ki point to heal an additional amount of ability damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

ki.name: Ki Pool (Su)
ki.desc: You command a ki pool equal to half your level + your Wisdom modifier. As a swift action you can spend 1 ki point to make one additional unarmed attack on a full attack, gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round, or increase your speed by 20 feet for 1 round. Your unarmed strikes count as magic for overcoming damage reduction.

ki.name: Composure (Su)
ki.desc: Your serene focus is a shield. While you have at least 1 ki point you gain a +1 bonus on saves against fear and emotion effects and increase the DC of Sense Motive checks against you by 2. As an immediate action you can spend 1 ki point to increase that DC by 10, and you can reduce the severity of any fear effect on you by one step.

ki.name: Four Ki Powers (Su)
ki.desc: Decades of discipline let you channel ki into supernatural feats. Choose four ki powers from the qunlocked monk list (such as elemental fury, barkskin, high jump, or a self-only abundant step). Each costs 1-2 ki points to activate and uses your monk-style ki pool.

ki.name: Diamond Body (Su)
ki.desc: Your purified body resists corruption. You are immune to poison and disease, and you may spend 1 ki point as an immediate action to reroll a failed Fortitude save.

ki.name: Perfect Self (Su)
ki.desc: You have transcended ordinary limits. Your ki pool increases by 50%. You gain damage reduction 10/chaotic, immunity to fear and charm effects, and you may learn ki powers of any level. Once per day you may spend 3 ki points to take an extra standard action on your turn.

divine.name: Orisons (Sp)
divine.desc: You can cast guidance, light, and stabilize at will as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Sacred Touch (Su)
divine.desc: As a standard action you can automatically stabilize a dying creature merely by touching it. You may also remove the fatigued condition from a willing creature by touch once per hour.

divine.name: Forever Acolyte (Sp)
divine.desc: Choose two spells of 1st or 2nd level from the cleric spell list. You can cast each of them twice per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Lay on Hands (Su)
divine.desc: You can heal wounds by touch, restoring 1d6 hit points per two character levels (minimum 1d6). You can do so a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier; using it on yourself is a swift action.

divine.name: Destructive Smite (Su)
divine.desc: You channel divine wrath into a blow. As a swift action, declare a destructive smite to add a morale bonus on a single melee damage roll equal to your character level (minimum 1). You can use this a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

divine.name: Domain Mastery (Sp)
divine.desc: You gain the granted power of one cleric domain and can cast that domain's 1st- and 2nd-level spells once each per day as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Divine Channeler (Su)
divine.desc: You channel positive (or negative) energy in a 30-foot burst to heal or harm for 1d6 per two character levels (Will half), usable 3 + your Charisma modifier times per day. In addition, once per day you may cast a 3rd-level divine spell of your choice (such as prayer, dispel magic, or searing light) as a spell-like ability.

divine.name: Voice of the God (Sp)
divine.desc: Once per day you can invoke a 6th-level divine spell as a spell-like ability — such as word of chaos, blade barrier, or heal — by shouting a prayer to your deity (caster level equal to your character level).

divine.name: Avatar of the Faith (Su)
divine.desc: Your deity's power flows through you. Once per day as a swift action you become an avatar for 1 minute, gaining DR 10/epic, fast healing 5, a +4 sacred bonus to AC and on saves, and immunity to fear and compulsion. Once per week you may cast a single 7th-level divine spell (such as resurrection or regenerate) as a spell-like ability.

arcane.name: Arcane Cantrips (Sp)
arcane.desc: You can cast detect magic, mage hand, prestidigitation, and ray of frost at will as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Apprentice Spellcasting (Sp)
arcane.desc: Choose two spells of 1st or 2nd level from the wizard/sorcerer spell list (such as mage armor, shield, or magic missile). You can cast each twice per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Arcane Pool (Su)
arcane.desc: You hold a reservoir of arcane energy equal to half your level + your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). As a swift action you can spend 1 point to grant a weapon you hold a +1 enhancement bonus (to a maximum of +1 per four levels) for 1 minute.

arcane.name: Spell Combat & Spellstrike (Su)
arcane.desc: You fight like a magus. Once per round you may cast a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action and make a melee attack in the same round (taking a -2 penalty on the attack). When you cast a touch spell, you may deliver it through a melee weapon strike as a free action.

arcane.name: Arcane Bombardment (Sp)
arcane.desc: Once per day each, you can cast fireball and lightning bolt as spell-like abilities at a caster level equal to your character level. You may apply one metamagic feat you know to these without increasing their casting time.

arcane.name: School Mastery (Sp)
arcane.desc: You gain the 1st-level granted power of one arcane school and can cast that school's signature 3rd-level spell once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level).

arcane.name: Archmage's Secret (Sp)
arcane.desc: Your mastery rivals an archmage. Your caster level increases by 2 for all your spellcasting and spell-like abilities. Once per day you may apply Quicken Spell to any spell you cast without increasing its level, and once per day you may cast a single 7th-level arcane spell (such as teleport, limited wish, or prismatic spray) as a spell-like ability.

alchemy.name: Alchemical Eye (Ex)
alchemy.desc: You gain a +4 bonus to identify potions and alchemical substances, and you can craft mundane alchemical items in half the normal time.

alchemy.name: Bombs (Su)
alchemy.desc: You can throw splash bombs a number of times per day equal to your character level + your Intelligence modifier. A direct hit deals 1d6 fire damage per two character levels (minimum 1d6) plus your Intelligence modifier; creatures in adjacent squares take splash damage equal to the minimum.

alchemy.name: Mutagen (Su)
alchemy.desc: Once per day you can brew and drink a mutagen. For 10 minutes per level it grants a +4 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score and a +2 natural armor bonus, at the cost of a -2 penalty to a mental ability score.

alchemy.name: Splash Weapon Mastery (Ex)
alchemy.desc: You treat thrown splash weapons as if you had the Far Shot feat, you add one extra adjacent square to any splash, and you may adjust the grid square a missed splash weapon lands in by one square.

alchemy.name: Greater Bombs & Discoveries (Su)
alchemy.desc: Your bombs improve and you learn two discoveries (such as explosive bomb, frost bomb, or stink bomb). You are immune to poison, and you can apply poison to a weapon without risk of poisoning yourself.

alchemy.name: Grand Alchemy (Su)
alchemy.desc: Once per day you can drink a grand mutagen granting a +8 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score and +6 natural armor. You also gain a grand discovery such as fast healing 5 while a mutagen is active, or an awakened intellect that grants a +2 inherent bonus to Intelligence.

skill.name: Quick Study (Ex)
skill.desc: You pick up the tricks of any trade. You gain a +1 bonus on two skills associated with your profession, and you can attempt those skills untrained.

skill.name: Persuasive (Ex)
skill.desc: You sway attitudes and intimidate with ease. You gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks; if you have 10 or more ranks in either skill, that bonus increases to +4 for it.

skill.name: Sneak Attack +1d6 (Ex)
skill.desc: When you catch a foe flat-footed or flanked, your precise strikes deal an extra 1d6 points of damage.

contextNotes.text: +1d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

skill.name: Weaponized Words (Ex)
skill.desc: You can use the Bluff skill to feint and demoralize in combat, and once per day you can plant a damaging quip that leaves a foe shaken for 1 minute (Will negates, DC 10 + half your level + your Charisma modifier).

skill.name: Roguish Talents (Ex)
skill.desc: Your sneak attack improves to +3d6, and you gain evasion and uncanny dodge (you take no damage on a successful Reflex save against effects that allow half, and you keep your Dexterity bonus to AC against unseen attackers).

contextNotes.text: +3d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

skill.name: Inspiring Performance (Su)
skill.desc: You can perform to inspire your allies a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + your Charisma modifier. While performing, allies who can hear you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls and on saves against fear and charm.

skill.name: Master of Disguise (Ex)
skill.desc: You can disguise yourself as a full-round action with a +10 bonus, and you gain a +5 bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks. Once per day you can read a creature's surface thoughts (as detect thoughts) by conversing with it.

skill.name: Living Legend (Ex)
skill.desc: Your reputation bends fate. Once per day you may reroll any d20 roll and take the better result. You add your Charisma modifier as a luck bonus on all saving throws, and you may take 10 on any skill check even under duress. Your sneak attack increases to +5d6 and you gain improved evasion.

contextNotes.text: +5d6 sneak attack vs flat-footed or flanked foes

craft.name: Skilled Hands (Ex)
craft.desc: Years at the workbench steady your hands. You gain a +2 bonus on your primary Craft or Profession skill and you can always take 10 on it, even when distracted.

craft.name: Master Craftsman (Ex)
craft.desc: You can use your Craft or Profession ranks in place of the caster-level prerequisite for item creation feats, and you craft masterwork goods in half the normal time and cost.

craft.name: Field Repair (Ex)
craft.desc: You gain a +4 bonus on Craft checks and can repair damaged gear or improvise tools in minutes rather than hours. Once per day you can restore a broken item to working order with a quick fix.

craft.name: Quality Goods (Ex)
craft.desc: Your wares command a premium. You earn your full Profession check result in gold pieces per week, and you gain a +2 bonus on Appraise checks.

craft.name: Artisan's Eye (Ex)
craft.desc: The campaign treats your crafting mastery as eight levels higher. You gain a +4 bonus on Appraise and can identify the maker, materials, and magical aura of any crafted object you study for 1 minute.

craft.name: Siege Engineer (Ex)
craft.desc: You are proficient with all siege weapons and can build or repair them at half cost and time. You gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls and to aim siege engines, and you can jury-rig traps and barricades during a short rest.

craft.name: Legendary Artisan (Su)
craft.desc: You craft magic items as though you possessed every item creation feat, using a caster level equal to your Craft/Profession ranks. Once per day you can imbue an item you have made with a temporary +1 enhancement bonus for 1 hour.

craft.name: Masterwork of Ages (Su)
craft.desc: You can create a single legendary masterwork, treating your effective caster level as your ranks + 5 and ignoring half the normal gp cost. Gear you personally craft grants its wielder a +2 competence bonus on checks made with it, and your finest creation counts as an artifact for the purpose of resisting destruction.

scholar.name: Lore Master (Ex)
scholar.desc: You gain a +2 bonus on all Knowledge checks and can always take 10 on them. You can attempt any Knowledge check untrained.

scholar.name: Bardic Knowledge (Ex)
scholar.desc: You add half your character level (minimum 1) to all Knowledge checks, and you can identify a creature's abilities and weaknesses as a free action on a successful check.

scholar.name: Forbidden Lore (Sp)
scholar.desc: You can cast comprehend languages, detect thoughts, and see invisibility, each twice per day as spell-like abilities (caster level equal to your character level).

scholar.name: Battle Tactician (Ex)
scholar.desc: Your study of warfare pays off. As a standard action you can study a foe to grant yourself and allies who can hear you a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls against it for 1 minute, and you gain a +4 bonus on a Knowledge check to identify it.

scholar.name: Sage's Insight (Sp)
scholar.desc: Once per day you can perform a legend lore-style divination, and your foresight grants a +2 insight bonus on initiative and prevents you from being caught flat-footed. Once per day you may cast a 3rd-level divination spell (such as arcane sight or speak with dead) as a spell-like ability.

scholar.name: Living Library (Sp)
scholar.desc: Your mind holds the knowledge of an age. Once per day you can learn the answer to a single question as if by commune. You gain a +4 insight bonus on all saving throws against mind-affecting effects, and once per day you may cast a 6th-level knowledge or divination spell (such as legend lore or true seeing on all allies) as a spell-like ability.

nature.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
nature.desc: You can improve the attitude of animals as you would influence a person, and you gain a +2 bonus on Survival checks and to track.

nature.name: Favored Terrain (Ex)
nature.desc: Choose one type of terrain. While in it you gain a +2 bonus on initiative and on Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, and you leave no trail and cannot be tracked unless you choose.

nature.name: Animal Companion (Ex)
nature.desc: You gain a loyal animal companion that advances as that of a druid of a level equal to half your character level (minimum 1).

nature.name: Favored Enemy (Ex)
nature.desc: Choose one creature type. You gain a +2 bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls against such creatures and a +4 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks regarding them.

contextNotes.text: +2 attack and damage vs favored enemy

nature.name: Hunter's Stride (Ex)
nature.desc: You move through natural difficult terrain at full speed and without leaving a trail, and in any natural terrain you can use Stealth even while being observed (hide in plain sight), gaining a +4 bonus on Stealth checks outdoors.

nature.name: Nature's Casting (Sp)
nature.desc: You can cast as a 4th-level druid, gaining a small list of nature spells (such as entangle, barkskin, and summon nature's ally II) usable as spell-like abilities a few times per day.

nature.name: One With the Wild (Su)
nature.desc: Once per day you can assume the form of a powerful beast (as beast shape III) for 1 hour. You gain DR 5/magic against natural creatures, immunity to natural environmental hazards, and the ability to speak with and command animals at will.

medical.name: Field Medic (Ex)
medical.desc: You gain a +4 bonus on Heal checks, can treat deadly wounds without a healer's kit, and grant a +2 bonus when stabilizing the dying.

medical.name: Healer's Touch (Sp)
medical.desc: You can cast cure light wounds three times per day as a spell-like ability, and you can remove the fatigued, shaken, or sickened condition from a creature by touch (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Chirurgeon (Su)
medical.desc: A number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier you can, by touch, heal 1 point of ability damage, cure a disease, or neutralize a poison. You gain a +2 bonus on all Heal checks.

medical.name: Anatomist (Ex)
medical.desc: As a move action you can study a living creature's anatomy; your attacks against it deal an extra 1d6 precision damage for 1 minute. You can use this on a number of creatures at once equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).

medical.name: Master Physician (Sp)
medical.desc: Once per day each you can cast lesser restoration, remove disease, and neutralize poison as spell-like abilities, and once per day you can cast breath of life to revive a creature that died within the last round (caster level equal to your character level).

medical.name: Miracle Worker (Sp)
medical.desc: You hold death at bay. Once per day you can cast raise dead as a spell-like ability. Allies within 30 feet of you gain fast healing 2, and you are immune to disease and to death effects and energy drain.

menial.name: Pool Cleaner (Ex)
menial.desc: A lifetime in the muck has left its mark. You gain a +10 bonus on Swim checks and on a single cleaning-related Profession or Craft check, and years of exposure have made you immune to poison.

menial.name: Gongfarmer's Constitution (Ex)
menial.desc: Nothing foul can turn your stomach. You are immune to disease and to the sickened and nauseated conditions caused by filth or stench, you gain a +4 bonus on saves against ingested poison, and you can eat or drink almost anything without harm.

menial.name: Tireless Drudge (Ex)
menial.desc: Endless labor has hardened you. You ignore fatigue caused by physical work, gain a +4 bonus on saves and checks to resist exhaustion, and can carry 25% more weight before becoming encumbered.

menial.name: Invisible Servant (Ex)
menial.desc: People overlook the help. You gain a +4 bonus on Stealth checks while performing menial work in plain sight, and you routinely overhear what you should not, gaining a +4 bonus on a single Perception or social skill to catch and recall secrets.
